svg.title: Turn a failed check into evidence
svg.desc: Record the versioned baseline, run the relevant check, review status and evidence, correct the owned dependency with an approved reversible change, then preserve before-and-after reports, rerun affected and final checks, and accept only when no blockers remain. Preserve reports before rerunning because the checker overwrites files. A scoped pass is not full readiness.

text.tspan: Turn a failed check into evidence
Reading order: 1 to 5, top to bottom. Unresolved findings keep deployment blocked.
Record baseline
Build and module versions; host and test scope
Time of capture
Run relevant check
Use actual nodes when required
Select the relevant validator for the recorded scope
Review finding
Status, severity and supporting evidence
Identify the accountable dependency owner
Correct owned dependency
Approved change and reversal plan
Correct the dependency with its named owner
Retest and decide
Preserve before/after; rerun affected and final checks
Accept only when no blockers remain
Preserve reports BEFORE rerun: the checker overwrites files.
Unresolved finding: keep deployment blocked and repeat from step 2.
A scoped pass is not full readiness.
